114        /**

121        public BuilderImpl( @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" ) final JavaComposer composer, final CharSequence name )

126        /**

130         *      builder instance.

132         */
133        @SuppressWarnings( {"OptionalUsedAsFieldOrParameterType"} )

142        /**
143         *  {@inheritDoc}
144         */
145        @API( status = STABLE, since = "0.2.0" )
146        @Override
147        public final BuilderImpl addAttribute( final FieldSpec fieldSpec, final boolean readOnly )
148        {
149            final var fieldSpecImpl = (FieldSpecImpl) requireNonNullArgument( fieldSpec, "fieldSpec" );
150            checkState( fieldSpecImpl.hasModifier( PRIVATE ), () -> new IllegalArgumentException( "Property %s needs to be private".formatted( fieldSpecImpl.name() ) ) );
151            addField( fieldSpecImpl );
152
153            final var fieldName = fieldSpecImpl.name();
154            final var propertyName = decapitalize( fieldName.startsWith( "m_" ) ? fieldName.substring( 2 )  : fieldName );
155
156            final Set<Modifier> modifiers = EnumSet.of( PUBLIC, FINAL );
157            if( fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) ) modifiers.add( STATIC );
158
159            final var accessor = getFactory().methodBuilder( propertyName )
160                .addModifiers( modifiers )
161                .returns( fieldSpecImpl.type() )
162                .addStatement( "return $N", fieldSpecImpl )
163                .build();
164            addMethod( accessor );
165
166            if( !(readOnly || fieldSpecImpl.hasModifier( FINAL )) )
167            {
168                final var param = getFactory().parameterBuilder( fieldSpecImpl.type(), "value", FINAL )
169                    .build();
170                final var setter = getFactory().methodBuilder( propertyName )
171                    .addModifiers( modifiers )
172                    .addParameter( param )
173                    .returns( VOID_PRIMITIVE )
174                    .addStatement( "$N = $N", fieldSpecImpl, param )
175                    .build();
176                addMethod( setter );
177            }
178
179            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
180            return this;
181        }   //  addAttribute()
182
183        /**
184         *  {@inheritDoc}
185         */
186        @Override
187        public final BuilderImpl addEnumConstant( final CharSequence name, final TypeSpec typeSpec )
188        {
189            final var typeSpecImpl = (ClassSpecImpl) requireNonNullArgument( typeSpec, "typeSpec" );
190            checkState( typeSpecImpl.anonymousTypeArguments().isPresent(), () -> new IllegalArgumentException( "enum constants must have anonymous type arguments" ) );
191            checkState( isValidName( name ), () -> new IllegalArgumentException( "not a valid enum constant: %s".formatted( name ) ) );
192            if( composer().addDebugOutput() )
193            {
194                final var builder = typeSpecImpl.toBuilder();
195                createDebugOutput( true ).ifPresent( debug -> builder.addJavadoc( "\n$L\n", debug.asLiteral() ) );
196                getEnumConstants().put( name.toString().intern(), (ClassSpecImpl) builder.build() );
197            }
198            else
199            {
200                getEnumConstants().put( name.toString().intern(), typeSpecImpl );
201            }
202
203            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
204            return this;
205        }   //  addEnumConstant()
206
207        /**
208         *  {@inheritDoc}
209         */
210        @Override
211        public final BuilderImpl addField( final FieldSpec fieldSpec )
212        {
213            final var fieldSpecImpl = (FieldSpecImpl) requireNonNullArgument( fieldSpec, "fieldSpec" );
214            super.addField( fieldSpecImpl );
215
216            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
217            return this;
218        }   //  addField()
219
220        /**
221         *  {@inheritDoc}
222         */
223        @Override
224        public final BuilderImpl addMethod( final MethodSpec methodSpec )
225        {
226            final var methodSpecImpl = (MethodSpecImpl) requireNonNullArgument( methodSpec, "methodSpec" );
227            checkState( methodSpecImpl.defaultValue().isEmpty(), () -> new IllegalStateException( "%s %s.%s cannot have a default value".formatted( ENUM, getName().orElse( NAME_ANONYMOUS_TYPE ), methodSpecImpl.name() ) ) );
228            checkState( !methodSpecImpl.hasModifier( DEFAULT ), () -> new IllegalStateException( "%s %s.%s cannot be default".formatted( ENUM, getName().orElse( NAME_ANONYMOUS_TYPE ), methodSpecImpl.name() ) ) );
229            if( composer().addDebugOutput() )
230            {
231                final var builder = methodSpecImpl.toBuilder();
232                createDebugOutput( true ).ifPresent( debug -> builder.addJavadoc( "\n$L\n", debug.asLiteral() ) );
233                getMethodSpecs().add( (MethodSpecImpl) builder.build() );
234            }
235            else
236            {
237                getMethodSpecs().add( methodSpecImpl );
238            }
239
240            final var maxMethods = composer().getMaxMethods();
241            if( (maxMethods > 0) && (getMethodSpecs().size() >= maxMethods) )
242            {
243                addSuppressableWarning( CLASS_WITH_TOO_MANY_METHODS );
244            }
245
246            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
247            return this;
248        }   //  addMethod()
249
250        /**
251         *  {@inheritDoc}
252         */
253        @Override
254        public final Builder addProperty( final FieldSpec fieldSpec, final boolean readOnly )
255        {
256            final var fieldSpecImpl = (FieldSpecImpl) requireNonNullArgument( fieldSpec, "fieldSpec" );
257            checkState( fieldSpecImpl.hasModifier( PRIVATE ), () -> new IllegalArgumentException( "Property %s needs to be private".formatted( fieldSpecImpl.name() ) ) );
258            addField( fieldSpecImpl );
259
260            final var fieldName = fieldSpecImpl.name();
261            final var propertyName = fieldName.startsWith( "m_" ) ? fieldName.substring( 2 ) : capitalize( fieldName );
262
263            final Set<Modifier> modifiers = EnumSet.of( PUBLIC, FINAL );
264            if( fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) ) modifiers.add( STATIC );
265
266            final var getter = getFactory().methodBuilder( "get" + propertyName )
267                .addModifiers( modifiers )
268                .returns( fieldSpecImpl.type() )
269                .addStatement( "return $N", fieldSpecImpl )
270                .build();
271            addMethod( getter );
272
273            if( !(readOnly || fieldSpecImpl.hasModifier( FINAL )) )
274            {
275                final var param = getFactory().parameterBuilder( fieldSpecImpl.type(), "value", FINAL )
276                    .build();
277                final var setter = getFactory().methodBuilder( "set" + propertyName )
278                    .addModifiers( modifiers )
279                    .addParameter( param )
280                    .returns( VOID_PRIMITIVE )
281                    .addStatement( "$N = $N", fieldSpecImpl, param )
282                    .build();
283                addMethod( setter );
284            }
285
286            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
287            return this;
288        }   //  addProperty()
289
290        /**
291         *  {@inheritDoc}
292         */
293        @Override
294        public final EnumSpecImpl build()
295        {
296            checkState( !getEnumConstants().isEmpty(), () -> new IllegalArgumentException( "at least one enum constant is required for %s".formatted( getName().orElse( NAME_ANONYMOUS_TYPE ) ) ) );
297
298            final var retValue = new EnumSpecImpl( this );
299
300            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
301            return retValue;
302        }   //  build()
303
304        /**
305         *  {@inheritDoc}
306         */
307        @SuppressWarnings( "AssignmentOrReturnOfFieldWithMutableType" )
308        @Override
309        protected final Map<String,ClassSpecImpl> getEnumConstants() { return m_EnumConstants; }
310
311        /**
312         *  {@inheritDoc}
313         */
314        @Override
315        public final BuilderImpl superclass( final TypeName superclass )
316        {
317            throw new IllegalStateException( "only classes have super classes, not " + ENUM );
318        }   //  superclass()
319    }

345    /**
346     *  Creates a dummy type spec for type-resolution in CodeWriter only while
347     *  emitting the type declaration but before entering the type body.
348     *
349     *  @param  type    The source type.
350     */
351    private EnumSpecImpl( @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" ) final EnumSpecImpl type )
352    {
353        super( type );
354        m_EnumConstants = Map.of();
355    }   //  TypeSpecImpl()

358    ====** Methods **==========================================================

360    /**
361     *  {@inheritDoc}
362     */
363    @Override
364    protected final TypeSpecImpl createCopy() { return new EnumSpecImpl( this ); }
365
366    /**
367     *  Emits the type to the given code writer, using the layout as defined
368     *  by the Foundation library code.
369     *
370     *  @param  codeWriter  The target code writer.
371     *  @param  enumName    The name of the enum; can be {@null}.
372     *  @param  implicitModifiers   The implicit modifiers.
373     *  @throws UncheckedIOException A problem occurred when writing to the
374     *      output target.
375     */
376    @SuppressWarnings( {"BoundedWildcard", "OptionalGetWithoutIsPresent", "OverlyLongMethod", "OverlyComplexMethod"} )
377    @Override
378    protected final void emit4Foundation( @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" ) final CodeWriter codeWriter, final String enumName, final Set<Modifier> implicitModifiers ) throws UncheckedIOException
379    {
380        assert isNull( enumName ) : "enumName has to be null";
381
382        /*
383         * Push an empty type (specifically without nested types) for
384         * type-resolution.
385         */
386        codeWriter.pushType( createCopy() );
387
388        codeWriter.emitJavadoc( getJavadoc() );
389        final Collection<AnnotationSpecImpl> annotations = new ArrayList<>( getAnnotations() );
390        getFactory().createSuppressWarningsAnnotation( getSuppressableWarnings() )
391            .map( a -> (AnnotationSpecImpl) a )
392            .ifPresent( annotations::add );
393        codeWriter.emitAnnotations( annotations, false );
394        codeWriter.emitModifiers( modifiers(), union( implicitModifiers, ENUM.asMemberModifiers() ) );
395        codeWriter.emit( "$L $L", ENUM.name().toLowerCase( ROOT ), name().get() );
396        codeWriter.emitTypeVariables( getTypeVariables() );
397
398        final var implementsTypes = getSuperInterfaces();
399        if( !implementsTypes.isEmpty() )
400        {
401            codeWriter.emit( " implements" );
402            var firstType = true;
403            for( final var type : implementsTypes )
404            {
405                if( !firstType ) codeWriter.emit( "," );
406                codeWriter.emit( " $T", type );
407                firstType = false;
408            }
409        }
410
411        codeWriter.popType();
412
413        codeWriter.emit( "\n{\n" );
414
415        codeWriter.pushType( this );
416
417        //---* Emit the class body *-------------------------------------------
418        codeWriter.indent();
419        var firstMember = true;
420
421        //---* Emit the enum constants *---------------------------------------
422        if( !getEnumConstants().isEmpty() )
423        {
424            codeWriter.emit(
425                """
426                    /*------------------*\\
427                ====** Enum Declaration **=================================================
428                    \\*------------------*/""" );
429            EmitEnumLoop:
430            for( final var iterator = new TreeMap<>( getEnumConstants() ).entrySet().iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); )
431            {
432                final var enumConstant = iterator.next();
433                codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
434                enumConstant.getValue().emit( codeWriter, enumConstant.getKey(), Collections.emptySet() );
435                if( iterator.hasNext() )
436                {
437                    codeWriter.emit( ",\n" );
438                }
439                else if( !getFieldSpecs().isEmpty() || !getMethodSpecs().isEmpty() || !innerClasses().isEmpty() )
440                {
441                    codeWriter.emit( ";\n" );
442                }
443                else
444                {
445                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
446                }
447            }   //  EmitEnumLoop:
448            firstMember = false;
449        }
450
451        //---* Emit the inner types *------------------------------------------
452        if( !innerClasses().isEmpty() )
453        {
454            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
455            codeWriter.emit(
456                """
457                    /*---------------*\\
458                ====** Inner Classes **====================================================
459                    \\*---------------*/""" );
460            innerClasses().stream()
461                .sorted( comparing( t -> t.name().get(), CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
462                .map( t -> (TypeSpecImpl) t )
463                .forEachOrdered( t ->
464                {
465                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
466                    t.emit( codeWriter, null, ENUM.implicitTypeModifiers() );
467                } );
468            firstMember = false;
469        }
470
471        //--- Constants and attributes *---------------------------------------
472        if( !getFieldSpecs().isEmpty() )
473        {
474            final Collection<FieldSpecImpl> alreadyHandled = new HashSet<>();
475
476            //---* Emit the constants *----------------------------------------
477            final var constants = getFieldSpecs().stream()
478                .filter( constantSpec -> constantSpec.hasModifier( PUBLIC ) )
479                .filter( constantSpec -> constantSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) )
480                .filter( constantSpec -> constantSpec.hasModifier( FINAL ) )
481                .filter( FieldSpecImpl::hasInitializer )
482                .sorted( comparing( FieldSpecImpl::name, CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
483                .toList();
484
485            if( !constants.isEmpty() )
486            {
487                if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
488                codeWriter.emit(
489                    """    
490                        /*-----------*\\
491                    ====** Constants **========================================================
492                        \\*-----------*/""" );
493                constants.forEach( constantSpec ->
494                {
495                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
496                    constantSpec.emit( codeWriter, ENUM.implicitFieldModifiers() );
497                    alreadyHandled.add( constantSpec );
498                } );
499                firstMember = false;
500            }
501
502            //---* Emit the attributes *---------------------------------------
503            final var attributes = getFieldSpecs().stream()
504                .filter( fieldSpec -> !alreadyHandled.contains( fieldSpec ) )
505                .filter( fieldSpec -> !(fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) && fieldSpec.hasModifier( FINAL )) )
506                .sorted( comparing( FieldSpecImpl::name, CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
507                .toList();
508
509            if( !attributes.isEmpty() )
510            {
511                if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
512                codeWriter.emit(
513                    """
514                        /*------------*\\
515                    ====** Attributes **=======================================================
516                        \\*------------*/""" );
517
518                attributes.forEach( a ->
519                {
520                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
521                    a.emit( codeWriter, ENUM.implicitFieldModifiers() );
522                    alreadyHandled.add( a );
523                } );
524                firstMember = false;
525            }
526
527            //---* Static fields *---------------------------------------------
528            final var statics = getFieldSpecs().stream()
529                .filter( staticSpec -> !alreadyHandled.contains( staticSpec ) )
530                .sorted( comparing( FieldSpecImpl::name, CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
531                .toList();
532            if( !statics.isEmpty() || !getStaticBlock().isEmpty() )
533            {
534                if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
535                codeWriter.emit(
536                    """
537                        /*------------------------*\\
538                    ====** Static Initialisations **===========================================
539                        \\*------------------------*/""" );
540
541                statics.forEach( staticSpec ->
542                {
543                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
544                    staticSpec.emit( codeWriter, ENUM.implicitFieldModifiers() );
545                    alreadyHandled.add( staticSpec );
546                } );
547
548                //---* Static Block *------------------------------------------
549                if( !getStaticBlock().isEmpty() )
550                {
551                    codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
552                    codeWriter.emit( getStaticBlock() );
553                }
554                firstMember = false;
555            }
556        }
557
558        //---* Constructors *--------------------------------------------------
559        final var constructors = getMethodSpecs().stream()
560            .filter( MethodSpecImpl::isConstructor )
561            .sorted( comparing( MethodSpecImpl::toString, CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER ) )
562            .toList();
563        if( !getInitializerBlock().isEmpty() || !constructors.isEmpty() )
564        {
565            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
566            codeWriter.emit(
567                """
568                    /*--------------*\\
569                ====** Constructors **=====================================================
570                    \\*--------------*/""" );
571
572            //---* Initializer block *-----------------------------------------
573            if( !getInitializerBlock().isEmpty() )
574            {
575                codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
576                codeWriter.emit( getInitializerBlock() );
577            }
578
579            //---* Emit the constructors *-------------------------------------
580            constructors.forEach( constructorSpec ->
581            {
582                codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
583                constructorSpec.emit( codeWriter, name(), ENUM.implicitMethodModifiers() );
584            } );
585            firstMember = false;
586        }
587
588        //---* Methods (static and non-static) *-------------------------------
589        final var methods = getMethodSpecs().stream()
590            .filter( methodSpec -> !methodSpec.isConstructor() )
591            .sorted( TypeSpecImpl::compareMethodSpecs )
592            .toList();
593        if( !methods.isEmpty() )
594        {
595            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
596            codeWriter.emit(
597                """
598                    /*---------*\\
599                ====** Methods **==========================================================
600                    \\*---------*/""" );
601
602            methods.forEach( methodSpec ->
603            {
604                codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
605                methodSpec.emit( codeWriter, name(), ENUM.implicitMethodModifiers() );
606            } );
607        }
608
609        codeWriter.unindent();
610        codeWriter.popType();
611
612        codeWriter.emit(
613            """
614            }
615            //  $L $N
616            """, ENUM.name().toLowerCase( ROOT ), this );
617    }   //  emit4Foundation()
618
619    /**
620     *  Emits the type to the given code writer, using the layout as defined
621     *  by the original JavaPoet code.
622     *
623     *  @param  codeWriter  The target code writer.
624     *  @param  enumName    The name of the enum; can be {@null}.
625     *  @param  implicitModifiers   The implicit modifiers.
626     *  @throws UncheckedIOException A problem occurred when writing to the
627     *      output target.
628     */
629    @SuppressWarnings( {"BoundedWildcard", "OptionalGetWithoutIsPresent", "OverlyLongMethod", "OverlyComplexMethod"} )
630    @Override
631    protected final void emit4JavaPoet( @SuppressWarnings( "UseOfConcreteClass" ) final CodeWriter codeWriter, final String enumName, final Set<Modifier> implicitModifiers ) throws UncheckedIOException
632    {
633        assert isNull( enumName ) : "enumName has to be null";
634
635        /*
636         * Push an empty type (specifically without nested types) for
637         * type-resolution.
638         */
639        codeWriter.pushType( createCopy() );
640
641        codeWriter.emitJavadoc( getJavadoc() );
642        final Collection<AnnotationSpecImpl> annotations = new ArrayList<>( getAnnotations() );
643        getFactory().createSuppressWarningsAnnotation( getSuppressableWarnings() )
644            .map( a -> (AnnotationSpecImpl) a )
645            .ifPresent( annotations::add );
646        codeWriter.emitAnnotations( annotations, false );
647        codeWriter.emitModifiers( modifiers(), union( implicitModifiers, ENUM.asMemberModifiers() ) );
648        codeWriter.emit( "$L $L", ENUM.name().toLowerCase( ROOT ), name().get() );
649        codeWriter.emitTypeVariables( getTypeVariables() );
650
651        final var implementsTypes = getSuperInterfaces();
652        if( !implementsTypes.isEmpty() )
653        {
654            codeWriter.emit( " implements" );
655            var firstType = true;
656            for( final var type : implementsTypes )
657            {
658                if( !firstType ) codeWriter.emit( "," );
659                codeWriter.emit( " $T", type );
660                firstType = false;
661            }
662        }
663
664        codeWriter.popType();
665
666        codeWriter.emit( " {\n" );
667
668        codeWriter.pushType( this );
669
670        //---* Emit the class body *-------------------------------------------
671        codeWriter.indent();
672        var firstMember = true;
673
674        //---* Emit the enum constants *---------------------------------------
675        for( final var iterator = new TreeMap<>( getEnumConstants() ).entrySet().iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); )
676        {
677            final var enumConstant = iterator.next();
678            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
679            enumConstant.getValue().emit( codeWriter, enumConstant.getKey(), Collections.emptySet() );
680            firstMember = false;
681            if( iterator.hasNext() )
682            {
683                codeWriter.emit( ",\n" );
684            }
685            else if( !getFieldSpecs().isEmpty() || !getMethodSpecs().isEmpty() || !innerClasses().isEmpty() )
686            {
687                codeWriter.emit( ";\n" );
688            }
689            else
690            {
691                codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
692            }
693        }
694
695        //---* Static fields *-------------------------------------------------
696        for( final var fieldSpec : getFieldSpecs() )
697        {
698            if( !fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) ) continue;
699            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
700            fieldSpec.emit( codeWriter, ENUM.implicitFieldModifiers() );
701            firstMember = false;
702        }
703
704        if( !getStaticBlock().isEmpty() )
705        {
706            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
707            codeWriter.emit( getStaticBlock() );
708            firstMember = false;
709        }
710
711        //--* Non-static fields *----------------------------------------------
712        for( final var fieldSpec : getFieldSpecs() )
713        {
714            if( fieldSpec.hasModifier( STATIC ) ) continue;
715            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
716            fieldSpec.emit( codeWriter, ENUM.implicitFieldModifiers() );
717            firstMember = false;
718        }
719
720        //---* Initializer block *---------------------------------------------
721        if( !getInitializerBlock().isEmpty() )
722        {
723            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
724            codeWriter.emit( getInitializerBlock() );
725            firstMember = false;
726        }
727
728        //---* Constructors *--------------------------------------------------
729        for( final var methodSpec : getMethodSpecs() )
730        {
731            if( !methodSpec.isConstructor() ) continue;
732            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
733            methodSpec.emit( codeWriter, name(), ENUM.implicitMethodModifiers() );
734            firstMember = false;
735        }
736
737        //---* Methods (static and non-static) *-------------------------------
738        for( final var methodSpec : getMethodSpecs() )
739        {
740            if( methodSpec.isConstructor() ) continue;
741            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
742            methodSpec.emit( codeWriter, name(), ENUM.implicitMethodModifiers() );
743            firstMember = false;
744        }
745
746        //---* Types (inner classes) *-----------------------------------------
747        for( final var typeSpec : innerClasses() )
748        {
749            if( !firstMember ) codeWriter.emit( "\n" );
750            ((TypeSpecImpl) typeSpec).emit( codeWriter, null, ENUM.implicitTypeModifiers() );
751            firstMember = false;
752        }
753
754        codeWriter.unindent();
755        codeWriter.popType();
756
757        codeWriter.emit( "}\n" );
758    }   //  emit4JavaPoet()
759
760    /**
761     *  {@inheritDoc}
762     */
763    @Override
764    public final boolean equals( final Object o )
765    {
766        var retValue = this == o;
767        if( !retValue && (o instanceof final EnumSpecImpl other) )
768        {
769            retValue = getFactory().equals( other.getFactory() ) && toString().equals( o.toString() );
770        }
771
772        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
773        return retValue;
774    }   //  equals()
775
776    /**
777     *  {@inheritDoc}
778     */
779    @SuppressWarnings( "AssignmentOrReturnOfFieldWithMutableType" )
780    @Override
781    protected final Map<String, ClassSpecImpl> getEnumConstants() { return m_EnumConstants; }
782
783    /**
784     *  {@inheritDoc}
785     */
786    @Override
787    public final int hashCode() { return hash( getFactory(), toString() ); }
788
789    /**
790     *  {@inheritDoc}
791     */
792    @Override
793    public final BuilderImpl toBuilder()
794    {
795        final var retValue = new BuilderImpl( getFactory(), name() );
796        retValue.getJavadoc().addWithoutDebugInfo( getJavadoc() );
797        retValue.getAnnotations().addAll( getAnnotations() );
798        retValue.getModifiers().addAll( modifiers() );
799        retValue.getTypeVariables().addAll( getTypeVariables() );
800        retValue.getSuperinterfaces().addAll( getSuperInterfaces() );
801        retValue.getEnumConstants().putAll( getEnumConstants() );
802        retValue.getFieldSpecs().addAll( getFieldSpecs() );
803        retValue.getMethodSpecs().addAll( getMethodSpecs() );
804        retValue.getTypeSpecs().addAll( typeSpecs() );
805        retValue.getInitializerBlock().addWithoutDebugInfo( getInitializerBlock() );
806        retValue.getStaticBlock().addWithoutDebugInfo( getStaticBlock() );
807        retValue.getStaticImports().addAll( getStaticImports() );
808        retValue.addSuppressableWarning( getSuppressableWarnings().toArray( SuppressableWarnings[]::new ) );
809
810        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
811        return retValue;
812    }   //  toBuilder()
813}
